name: green-level-label-visible-on
note: G6 ON side. `label_visible=`/`text_visible=` bind label visibility to an input.bool; with the input at its default (true) every item must CARRY its label -- this half exists so a mutant that unconditionally drops labels fails, not just the OFF half's mutant that never drops them. Geometry is hand-derived: the condition is true only at bar 2, extend.bars bars=1 closes at x2 = 3. Pair: green-level-label-visible-off replays the SAME source with {"show": false}.
source:
indicator("V", shorttitle="V", overlay=true)
show = input.bool(true, "Show Labels")
plotlevel(bar_index == 2, close, "L", label="R1", label_visible=show, extend=extend.bars, bars=1)
plotzone(bar_index == 2, high, low, "Z", text="OB", text_visible=show, extend=extend.bars, bars=1)
